segments.zh: 水痘通常是小时候得的一种病，发病时全身会冒出小红点，就像被蚊子叮的小包。

segments.en: So most people get this when they're children.
segments.zh: 所以大多数人都是在小时候得这个病。

segments.en: Exactly, and what makes you very uncomfortable when you get chickenpox, as you said, it's these little red dots, they itch, just like mosquito bites, but you can't scratch because if you do, then your skin gets like marked, right?

segments.en: Forever.

segments.zh: 我小时候没得过，而且听说成年人得水痘甚至可能会死。

segments.en: Are you serious?

segments.en: Definitely, and well, he's got a funny solution for it.

segments.en: There are two words, to itch and to scratch.

segments.zh: 但是这个人很痒，所以这意味着你的皮肤，你想抓挠它。

segments.en: It's maybe uncomfortable.
Like a mosquito bite is itchy.

segments.zh: 好吧，那么痒是形容词，对吧？

segments.en: To the noun, an itch.

segments.en: You don't really feel very well.

segments.en: Oh gosh, now this is a dangerous one.

segments.en: Someone who is contagious can pass their illness to someone else.
segments.zh: 有传染性的人会把病传给其他人。

segments.en: So for example, the flu is very contagious and if I have the flu, Marco doesn't want me to, you know, come over and touch all of his stuff and sneeze and cough into his food.
segments.zh: 比如流感传染性很强，如果我得了流感，马可肯定不希望我过来，到处碰他的东西，还对着他的食物打喷嚏、咳嗽。

segments.en: Right, exactly.
So that's contagious.

segments.zh: 这是一个形容词，这意味着您很容易将疾病传递给另一个人。

segments.en: Exactly.

segments.en: Example one.

segments.zh: 水痘具有很强的传染性。

segments.en: They might have a contagious rash.
segments.zh: 他们可能有传染性皮疹。

segments.en: A rash is just basically a part of your skin that becomes irritated or uncomfortable and sometimes it turns red or pink.
segments.zh: 皮疹基本上就是某一块皮肤受到刺激、感觉不舒服，有时还会变成红色或粉红色。

segments.en: Exactly.

segments.zh: 所以，正如你所说，它发生的原因不同。

segments.en: Sometimes you maybe have bad seafood in your skin and you start to have rashes all over your body.
segments.zh: 有时可能吃了变质的海鲜，皮肤就开始全身起疹子。

segments.en: Other times you can touch some plants that are dangerous like poison ivy or poison oak.

segments.en: And then you get a big rash.

segments.zh: 第一个词 bio 来自单词 biology。

segments.en: So that's something that is alive.
An animal, a plant or a person.

segments.en: So a biohazard is a, well, something that's alive that's dangerous.
segments.zh: 所以 biohazard 就是有生命、且危险的东西。

segments.en: Right.
Something that's dangerous towards a living person, right, or organism.
segments.zh: 对活人或者有机体有危险的东西。

segments.en: For example, you don't want to be near an area that has a lot of radiation.
segments.zh: 例如，您不想靠近有大量辐射的区域。

segments.en: It's a biohazard.
Exactly.

segments.zh: 或其中一些疾病，如埃博拉病毒。

segments.en: These are very dangerous towards living things.

segments.zh: 所以生物危害就是它的名字。

segments.en: Exactly.
And usually there's a symbol, a very clear symbol that kind of looks like a triangle and it's red.
segments.zh: 通常会有一个很醒目的标志，看起来有点像三角形，是红色的。

Well, we're curious to know, have you had the chicken pox?
segments.zh: 好吧，我们很想知道，你得过水痘吗？

segments.en: And if you did, was it really itchy or were you a lucky one and it wasn't so bad?
segments.zh: 如果你得过，是很痒，还是你很幸运、没那么严重？

segments.en: So let us know on our website, englishpod.com.
segments.zh: 因此，请在我们的网站 englishpod.com 上告诉我们。

segments.en: Right.
And if you ever had any other common childhood illnesses like the mumps or the measles, right, you can also tell us about that.
segments.zh: 如果你小时候还得过腮腺炎、麻疹等其他常见的儿童疾病，也可以告诉我们。

segments.en: So we'll see you guys there and until next time.
segments.zh: 所以我们会在那里见到你们，直到下一次。

segments.en: Bye everyone.
